name: api_proposal_public_accept
_description: Fase D.3 (3b/3) - Endpoint PUBLICO (sin JWT) que registra la decision del cliente sobre una propuesta (accepted | rejected | revision_requested). Token = autorizacion. Es idempotente: si la propuesta ya tenia accepted_at, devuelve 409. Persiste rastro en proposal_acceptances (inmutable) + actualiza proposals.status/accepted_at/accepted_via/accepted_metadata.

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.project_id, p.status, p.accepted_at, p.public_token_expires_at, pr.tenant_id, pr.name AS project_name FROM proposals p JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id WHERE p.public_token = $1::text LIMIT 1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details, accepted_at: $json.accepted_at || null, accepted_via: $json.accepted_via || null, expired_at: $json.expired_at || null } }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO proposal_acceptances (proposal_id, tenant_id, decision, signer_name, signer_email, comments, ip_address, user_agent, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::text, $8::text, $9::jsonb) RETURNING id, decided_at

UPDATE proposals SET status = CASE $2::text WHEN 'accepted' THEN 'accepted' WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN 'revision_requested' THEN 'revision_requested' ELSE status END, accepted_at = now(), accepted_via = 'public_link', accepted_metadata = $3::jsonb, client_response_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status, accepted_at

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Check Decidable').first().json.proposal_id, $('Check Decidable').first().json.decision, JSON.stringify({ signer_name: $('Check Decidable').first().json.signer_name, signer_email: $('Check Decidable').first().json.signer_email, ip_address: $('Check Decidable').first().json.ip_address, user_agent: $('Check Decidable').first().json.user_agent, acceptance_id: $('Insert Acceptance').first().json.id, request_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.request_id })] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO activity_log (project_id, agent_name, action, status, details) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'api_proposal_public_accept', $2::text, $3::text, $4::jsonb)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Check Decidable').first().json.project_id, 'proposal_' + $('Check Decidable').first().json.decision, $('Check Decidable').first().json.decision === 'accepted' ? 'success' : 'warning', JSON.stringify({ proposal_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.proposal_id, decision: $('Check Decidable').first().json.decision, signer_name: $('Check Decidable').first().json.signer_name, channel: 'public_link', request_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.request_id })] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { proposal_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.proposal_id, project_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.project_id, decision: $('Check Decidable').first().json.decision, acceptance_id: $('Insert Acceptance').first().json.id, decided_at: $('Insert Acceptance').first().json.decided_at, new_status: ($('Update Proposal Status').first() ? $('Update Proposal Status').first().json.status : null) }, meta: { request_id: $('Check Decidable').first().json.request_id, channel: 'public_link' } }) }}
